chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: How the Tatum trio broke up
summary: An agent persuaded Tatum to work alone; Grimes was away, later running into Tatum in Canada while with the Highlanders.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Tell me again about the breakup of the trio.

The only thing I can remember about that was we were workin' I think still at the 3 Deuces -- back again. We were in and out of there. And it was said that there would be a vacation -- we weren't gonna work for four or eight weeks or somethin'. That sounded funny 'cause we were in demand, you know. This was the guy, it was a pity he did this thing, whoever did it, persuaded Tatum that he could make as much money on his own as with the trio, you know. And it fell through so now the trio was gone. They tried to get it back together again but it just didn't happen. I was away. Slam got with him for a while with Everett Barksdale, but it just didn't go.
Did this happen while you were in New York?

No, at that time I don't know where, I think I may have been in Cleveland. I know I ran across 'em in Canada. We ran across each other, in Canada. And I was [with] the Highlanders at that time. I remember that. And they were working somewhere and we came through, or we were working there. I think we were working there 'cause I went to see him more than once.
